about: The way to the sky lift signposted (review fix: tools/bake/skylift/Signs and the station's frontage). Bake and export as review_views.json says, then render.py --views docs/renders/skylift/signs_views.json.

views.name: s_centre_finger
views.desc: The town's central crossing, from the north-east corner: the fingerpost on the south-west corner pointing west to the sky lift.

views.name: s_westside_mid
views.desc: The westside street where the centre's cross street comes in: the fingerpost on the east sidewalk pointing south.

views.name: s_street_end
views.desc: Walking south down the westside street toward its end: the pylon where Lift Road begins, the station beyond.

views.name: s_lift_road
views.desc: Lift Road from the pylon: the banners on the lamp posts, the shelter with its map board, the station at the end.

views.name: s_station_front
views.desc: The base station from the car park: the canopy over the steps, the benches, the bike rack and the flags.

views.name: s_street_end_night
views.desc: The street's end at night: the floodlit pylon and Lift Road's lamps.
